exposure: Treatment group (oxytocin alone, misoprostol alone, combined oxytocin and misoprostol)
outcome: Hemoglobin level before and 24 hours after surgery
cohort: 150 women aged 18-40 years with singleton term pregnancies scheduled for cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Compared to oxytocin or misoprostol alone, a combined lower dose of misoprostol and oxytocin significantly reduced blood loss during and after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: This study found that a combined lower dose of misoprostol-oxytocin significantly reduced blood loss during and after cesarean section compared to higher dose oxytocin and misoprostol alone.
